SELECT f.tickersym, f.yieldrate, f.expensenet, 
       CASE WHEN f.expensenet > 0 THEN f.yieldrate / f.expensenet ELSE NULL END as yter,
       SUM(CASE WHEN br.creditmark IN ('us_government', 'aaa', 'aa') THEN ba.allocationpct ELSE 0 END) as hq_alloc,
       SUM(ba.allocationpct) as total_bond_alloc
FROM funds f
JOIN bond_allocations ba ON f.tickersym = ba.fundlink
JOIN bond_ratings br ON ba.ratinglink = br.ratekey
GROUP BY f.tickersym, f.yieldrate, f.expensenet
LIMIT 5;

SELECT MAX(
    (f.yieldrate / f.expensenet) * 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN br.creditmark IN ('us_government', 'aaa', 'aa') THEN ba.allocationpct ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ba.allocationpct))
) as max_secure_income_score
FROM funds f
JOIN bond_allocations ba ON f.tickersym = ba.fundlink
JOIN bond_ratings br ON ba.ratinglink = br.ratekey
WHERE f.yieldrate IS NOT NULL AND f.expensenet > 0;
